name: dimfort-vscode
description: Dimensional homogeneity checker for Fortran (LSP client).

commands.title: Toggle Full Unit Trace in Hover

dimfort.executable.description: Path to the `dimfort` executable. Override if the binary isn't on $PATH (e.g. point at a virtualenv: /path/to/.venv/bin/dimfort).

dimfort.trace.server.description: Trace LSP messages between VSCode and the DimFort server (visible in the Output panel).

dimfort.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inline ghost-text units next to each variable reference.

dimfort.completion.enabled.description: Suggest known unit names when typing inside `@unit{…}`.

dimfort.codeActions.enabled.description: Offer a quick fix that inserts a `!< @unit{}` annotation on variable declarations that lack one.

dimfort.gotoDefinition.enabled.description: Enable Go to Definition on variables and function/subroutine calls.

dimfort.codeLens.enabled.description: Show a CodeLens above each function/subroutine definition with its inferred signature. Off by default — can be visually busy on dense files; turn on with the `DimFort: Toggle Code Lens` command.

dimfort.trace.enabled.description: When hovering inside an assignment, show the full unit-trace tree (every rule fire: R3.1, R5.1, …) that produced the RHS unit, instead of the compact hover. Off by default — informative for debugging wrapper-arithmetic diagnostics (D1.2 / D1.3 / D1.6) but makes hovers taller. Toggle with the `DimFort: Toggle Full Unit Trace in Hover` command.

dimfort.semanticTokens.enabled.description: Experimental — tag every identifier whose declaration carries no `@unit{}` annotation (and isn't covered by the INTEGER/LOGICAL/CHARACTER intrinsic default) with the `variable.unannotated` semantic-token modifier. Themes that style this modifier render those names distinctly (e.g. faded) so annotation coverage is visible at a glance. No visual change unless your theme has `editor.semanticTokenColorCustomizations` for `variable.unannotated`. Off by default. Toggle with the `DimFort: Toggle Unannotated-Variable Highlighting` command.

dimfort.maxWorksetSize.description: Maximum number of files included in a single check pipeline. On large workspaces (e.g. LMDZ: 2435 files) the full transitive use-closure can be too deep to compile in memory; when it exceeds this cap, DimFort keeps the active file plus its nearest dependencies in topo order. Restart the language server to apply.

dimfort.externalModules.description: Extra module names treated as external (i.e. not resolved against the workspace; no U007 diagnostic when missing). Extends DimFort's built-in allowlist (Fortran intrinsics, mpi, netcdf, ioipsl, …). Restart the language server to apply.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: Variable reference whose declaration carries no @unit{} annotation and isn't covered by the INTEGER / LOGICAL / CHARACTER intrinsic-type default. Style with `editor.semanticTokenColorCustomizations` to see annotation coverage at a glance.
